name: Can AKN Design Group help with both interior and exterior elements of a large-scale remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can AKN Design Group help with both interior and exterior elements of a large-scale remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AKN Design Group specializes in coordinating both interior and exterior elements as part of a comprehensive large-scale remodel. Our expertise extends to high-end outdoor living spaces, such as custom patios and outdoor kitchens, seamlessly integrating them with interior renovations like luxury kitchens or whole-home transformations. This integrated design-build approach ensures a cohesive vision across your entire property, enhancing functionality, beauty, and long-term value. We manage everything from foundation work and structural integration to interior finishes and exterior tie-ins, providing a single point of coordination for a unified outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AKN Design Group coordinates both interior and exterior elements in large-scale remodels, including high-end outdoor living spaces. Our integrated design-build approach ensures a cohesive vision and unified outcome for your entire property.
